crossRefs.note: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.
I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all…
Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

translations.web: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.
translations.bsb: When the devil had finished every temptation, he left Him until an opportune time.
translations.kjv: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
translations.asv: And when the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him for a season.
